issues.message: A chart must be an object.
Series id "rev" is used twice; the second was renamed.
yAxis.min must be greater than 0 on a logarithmic axis (or null for automatic); got 0.

type must be one of "bar", "line", "area", "scatter", "bubble", "pie", "donut", "radar", "waterfall", "histogram", "box", "funnel", "treemap", "sunburst", "sankey", "streamgraph", "slope", "likert", "parliament", "barrace", "choropleth"; got "bad-type".
series[0] must be an object with a name and values.
series[1].values[0] is not a number: "bad".
series[1].sizes must not be negative.
Custom error bars need plus and / or minus amounts, one per category.
stderr error bars take no value; the amount comes from the data.
A logarithmic trendline cannot have a fixed intercept; use linear, polynomial or exponential.
palette must list at least one colour.
innerRadius must be a number from 0 to 0.9.
gapWidth must be a number from 0 to 0.9.
overlap must be a number from -1 to 1.
bins must be a whole number from 1 to 500, or null for automatic.
referenceLines[0].value must be a number (where the line crosses the axis).
referenceLines[1] has no "extra"; it takes value, label, axis and color.
referenceBands[0] needs numbers for from and to (the ends of the band on its axis).
parliamentMajority must be a whole number of seats, 1 or more, or null for half plus one.
mapSteps must be a whole number of colour classes from 2 to 9.
mapThresholds must be up to 8 numbers in ascending order (the class breaks), or [] for equal classes.
raceTopN must be a whole number of bars from 1 to 30.
radarTicks must be a whole number from 1 to 50, or null for round-number rings.
yAxis.max (50) must be greater than yAxis.min (100).
yAxis.step must be greater than 0 (or null for automatic).
yAxis.logBase must be a number from 2 to 1000 (default 10).
yAxis2.min must be greater than 0 on a logarithmic axis (or null for automatic); got -10.
A logarithmic yAxis cannot show percent stacking (shares from 0% to 100% include 0); use stacking "stacked" or "none", or a linear axis.
A logarithmic yAxis2 cannot show percent stacking (shares from 0% to 100% include 0); use stacking "stacked" or "none", or a linear axis.
"Europe" is a group: its value is the sum of its children, so the value given was ignored.
"France" appears twice under the same group in tree[0].children; sibling names must be unique, so the second was left out.
The flow from "Purchase" to "Visit" would close a loop (Visit already leads back to Purchase); flows must only go forwards, so it was left out.
The flow from "Visit" to "Signup" appears twice; add the values into one flow. The second was left out.
links[4] goes from "Same" to itself; a flow must join two different nodes.
sankeyNodes names "Unused", which no flow uses; it was left out.
"bad" in Cost (Q2) is not a number; it was left blank.
"bad" in Q2 (Cost) is not a number; it was left blank.
sankeyNodes names "Ghost", which no flow uses; it was left out.

descriptions: Sales: a bar chart showing 2 series over 4 categories (Q1 to Q4). North ranges from 10 (Q1) to 50 (Q4), rising, up 400% from first to last. South ranges from 20 (Q4) to 40 (Q1), falling, down 50% from first to last. The value axis is logarithmic (base 10). The secondary value axis is reversed. North has ±5% error bars.
Share: a pie chart of Share across 3 categories, totalling 100. The largest is A at 50 (50%); the smallest is C at 20 (20%).
A sunburst chart of Values across 1 categories, totalling 100. The largest is Europe at 100 (100%); the smallest is Europe at 100 (100%). The data is grouped 2 levels deep with 2 items.
A map chart of Europe shading 2 regions by GDP: highest Germany (4,100), lowest France (2,800). 1 category names no region.
Top Languages: a bar race chart of 3 names over 3 time points (2020 to 2022), showing the top 2. JS leads at 2020 with 50; Python leads at 2022 with 80.
A sankey chart of 2 flows between 3 nodes, from A to C. The largest flow is A → B (30); all flows add up to 50.
A parliament chart of 300 seats across 3 groups: no group reaches the majority of 151; the largest is Left with 120.
A slope chart from 2023 to 2024: 1 of 3 rose and 1 fell. The biggest rise is A (15); the biggest fall is B (-10).
A likert chart of 2 questions with 3 answers from Disagree to Agree. Most positive: Ease of use (70%); least: Speed (50%).
A streamgraph chart of 2 series over 3 categories (Jan to Mar), stacked symmetrically around a center baseline with a peak volume of 45.
A waterfall chart of Cash: 2 increases and 1 decrease over 5 steps, ending at a total of 70.
A histogram chart of Scores. Scores: 3 values from 10 to 30, mean 20.
